findings.message: Final render failed before capture. render.log reports: Couldn't find file for package /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2, then Failed to load package, then Couldn't connect to RPC server, giving up, followed by AssertionError.

The source map file exists in repo content at cpp/unreal_projects/SpearSim/Content/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2.umap, but the standalone runtime path search found no matching cafeteria_500sqft_v2 files under cpp/unreal_projects/SpearSim/Standalone-Development/Linux. The standalone package likely needs to be recooked/staged with this map.
No metadata.json, RGB frames, or MP4s were produced, so scene_off_flashlight_off darkness and scene_off_flashlight_on soft falloff could not be evaluated.

Intended output paths, if the render succeeds after recook, are examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_soft_falloff_validation/scene_off_flashlight_off/rgb.mp4 and examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_soft_falloff_validation/scene_off_flashlight_on/rgb.mp4, with frames under each setting's frames/rgb/ directory.
No product source, tests, docs, Git state, or unrelated tmux sessions were modified.
